name: Halo imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, a floating ring of ten small glowing embers circling its horns like a burning halo, smug half-closed eyes

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings with arms folded, the ring of embers circling its head
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers smugly, wings beating slowly, the halo of embers turning round its horns

attack.action: throws its arms wide and puffs its cheeks, breathing the whole ring of embers outward in every direction, then a new ring sparks back around its horns

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
